summary: HUYA Inc., a NYSE-listed Chinese game streaming and services company, filed a Form 6-K reporting Q2 2026 results and announced its board approved increasing its 2026 Share Repurchase Program from US$50 million to US$100 million. The increase reflects management confidence in the business outlook and commitment to shareholder value. No specific share quantities, prices, or timing were disclosed beyond the authorized amount. The filing also noted non-GAAP net income of US$5.4 million. Watch for subsequent repurchase execution disclosures and any impact on share count or EPS.
